scope: Predeclared development comparison; no policy promotion from training return or isolated stopping successes
selection: Rank completed development arms by combined progress-and-stop passes, then fewer falls; report all arms. A reduction is condition-specific, not general acceptance.

held_out_conditions.scope: Evaluate the selected candidate and cycle-05 on the same conditions; retain every result

integrated_gate: Integrated candidate trials only after all development and held-out stopping/progress conditions pass; deployed cycle-05 remains unchanged until qualification supports promotion.
